research.name: RemotionUI
research.note: A shadcn-style registry of over 200 Remotion video components, such as captions, transitions, charts and scenes, installed as source by CLI.

effects: Karaoke Captions with an active-word underline that fills word by word
IK rig rebuilt as a plotting SCARA arm

unverified: The component source is public in the MIT repository riaz37/remotion-ui (linked from the site); that repository has not yet been researched as its own candidate.
Only Karaoke Captions was seen rendered; the Grid Pixelate Wipe, Audiogram and SCARA arm entries come from component links and a commit message.
